name: Checkimate — WooCommerce Checkout, Abandoned Cart Recovery & Order Bumps
author: Checkimate Media

sections.description:
Checkimate gives your WooCommerce store the checkout experience Shopify is known for — clean, fast, two-column, and built to convert. No page builders. No setup. Activate and it’s live.

The optimized checkout page, order summary, and thank-you page are completely free. No license needed to get started.

The default WooCommerce checkout is built to work, not built to convert. It is cluttered, outdated, and looks nothing like the checkout experiences customers expect from modern stores. Checkimate fixes this instantly — replacing your checkout with a focused, professional layout that feels native to your store, not like a plugin was bolted on.

What You Get For Free

  • ✅ Shopify-style two-column checkout layout — billing fields on the left, live order summary on the right. Distraction-free. Fast. Beautiful.
  • ✅ Custom thank-you page — branded order confirmation that keeps customers engaged after purchase
  • ✅ Mobile-optimized — single-column stacked layout on phones, tested across all major themes
  • ✅ Auto-detects your logo — pulls your existing site logo on activation, no setup needed
  • ✅ Clean coupon field — inline coupon input with instant validation, no page reloads
  • ✅ Blocks-compatible — forces classic checkout even if your theme uses Gutenberg blocks
  • ✅ Works on any theme — fully isolated layout, zero theme conflicts

Why Store Owners Switch

Shopify stores convert better at checkout — not because of their products, but because of their checkout design. Clean layout. Live order summary. No distractions. That experience has been out of reach for WooCommerce stores. Until now.

Checkimate brings that same checkout experience to WooCommerce. Activate it, and your checkout looks and feels like it was built by a world-class design team — in under 2 minutes, on any theme, for free.

“The checkout experience is one of the highest-leverage things you can optimize in ecommerce. Most stores leave serious money on the table simply because their checkout looks untrustworthy.”

Pro Features (License Required)

Upgrade to Checkimate Pro at checkimate.com to unlock the full revenue recovery and conversion engine:

🛒 Cart Recovery Emails
Automated 3-stage email sequences that recover abandoned checkouts on autopilot. Customers who abandon get a reminder at 1 hour, a follow-up at 24 hours, and a personalized discount coupon at 72 hours. Industry average recovery rate is 5–8%. Checkimate averages 14%+.

📦 Order Bumps
Rule-based inline product offers shown inside the checkout — one click to add. No redirects, no friction. Proven to increase average order value by 15–30% without disrupting checkout flow.

🎨 Checkout Design & Branding
Full brand customization — primary color, logo sizing, button styles, and more. Make the checkout look like it was purpose-built for your store.

🛡️ Trust Badges
Configurable trust icons displayed below the checkout form. Customizable text, multiple badge styles. Reduces buyer hesitation at the exact moment it matters most.

📊 Advanced Analytics
Deep-dive funnel metrics — revenue at risk, revenue recovered, abandonment trends, conversion pipeline, and CSV export. Know exactly where your store is losing and recovering money.

👥 Audience CRM (Customer Contacts)
Full customer profiles with checkout history, email capture, cart value tracking, and conversion status. Every person who touched your checkout, organized and searchable.

📧 Email Campaigns
Customize every recovery email — subject lines, body copy, discount amounts, and send timing. Full template editor with live inbox preview and test send.

🪜 Multi-Step Checkout
Break the checkout into a clean 3-step flow (Contact → Shipping → Payment). Proven to increase completion rates by 27%+ by making the process feel shorter and less overwhelming.

📍 Google Address Autocomplete
Instant address autofill powered by Google Maps Places API. Eliminates delivery failures from typos and dramatically speeds up checkout on mobile.

📋 Email Delivery Log
Complete send history for every recovery email — recipient, stage, subject, delivery status, and timestamp. Know exactly what every customer received and when.

Pricing

All plans are annual licenses. View current pricing at checkimate.com →

  • Starter — 1 site
  • Pro — 5 sites
  • Agency — 15 sites

Staging and development sites are always free and never count against your site limit.

Privacy

Checkimate sends basic technical data to checkimate.com to validate licenses and deliver automatic plugin updates (site URL, WordPress version, WooCommerce version). No personal customer data is ever transmitted outside your server. See the full privacy policy at checkimate.com/privacy.

External services used:

  • checkimate.com — license validation, plugin updates, and anonymous usage telemetry. Privacy Policy
  • ip-api.com — server geolocation for admin install notifications (server IP only, not customer IPs)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the checkimate folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Checkimate → Start Here in your WordPress admin
  4. Your checkout is already live — visit your store’s checkout page to see it

To unlock Pro features, purchase a license at checkimate.com, then go to Checkimate → License and enter your key.
sections.faq:
Can this make my WooCommerce checkout look like Shopify?

That is exactly what it does. Checkimate replaces the default WooCommerce checkout with a modern two-column layout — the same style used by high-converting Shopify stores. Clean left column for billing fields, live order summary on the right, mobile-optimized, distraction-free. Same experience, fully inside WooCommerce, completely free.

Does this work with my theme?

Yes. Checkimate uses a fully isolated checkout layout that overrides the default WooCommerce template entirely. It is not affected by your theme’s CSS or template files. Tested with Astra, Blocksy, OceanWP, Hello Elementor, Storefront, GeneratePress, and Kadence.

Will this break my existing WooCommerce setup?

No. Checkimate only replaces the checkout page layout. Your products, orders, payment gateways, shipping methods, and all other WooCommerce functionality continues working exactly as before.

Does the free version require a license?

No. The optimized checkout page, order summary, and thank-you page are completely free with no license required. A Pro license unlocks cart recovery emails, order bumps, analytics, and the other advanced features listed above.

Does it work with WooPayments, Stripe, PayPal?

Yes. Checkimate is compatible with all standard WooCommerce payment gateways including WooPayments, Stripe, PayPal, Square, and any other gateway that follows WooCommerce standards. WooPayments card fields are automatically styled to match your checkout design.

Does it work with variable products and subscriptions?

Yes. Variable products, WooCommerce Subscriptions, and all standard WooCommerce product types work correctly.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Checkimate automatically restores the default WooCommerce checkout when deactivated. No permanent changes are made to your store configuration.

Can I use it on staging or development sites?

Yes. Staging sites are always free and never count against your license site limit. Checkimate automatically detects localhost, .local, .test, .dev, and common managed hosting staging environments including WP Engine, Kinsta, and Cloudways.

Is my customer data safe?

Yes. All customer data — cart details, emails, names, addresses — stays entirely within your own WordPress database. It is never sent to checkimate.com or any third party. The only data sent externally is technical metadata about your WordPress installation for license validation.

Does cart recovery comply with GDPR?

Cart recovery emails are sent only to customers who voluntarily entered their email at your checkout. You should include a disclosure in your store’s privacy policy that partial checkout data may be used for cart recovery communications, which is standard practice for WooCommerce stores.

How many sites can I use it on?

The free version can be installed on unlimited sites. Pro features require a license per your plan’s site limit (1 site, 5 sites, or 15 sites). Staging sites are always free on all plans.
